data.name: Miravis
data.detailed_description:
This is a uniquely styled action-adventure game with fast-paced, satisfying combat. In this chaotic Infinite Realm, defeat monsters, gather resources, upgrade your stronghold, and hunt down the mastermind behind all the chaos. Embark on a flavor-packed grand adventure through meticulously designed worlds.

The game focuses on fluid action combat, diverse weapon choices and enemy strategies, as well as a distinctive voxel art style.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Unrivaled, Challenging, and Witty Diverse Combat Experience

In a world where fantasy and sci-fi merge, choose to confront otherworldly monsters with skill or wit.

Guns, explosives, or visceral medieval blade-to-flesh duels. Elegant action interactions or tech-driven domination over primitive beasts — the choice is yours.

Fluid combat with a variety of weapons, utilizing items and the environment to engage in exhilarating action battles — or turn the tables by making enemies struggle through your traps and gadgets.

Travel Through Beautiful Fantasy Worlds and Reap the Rewards

Vast maps with distinctively themed regions satisfy your desire for exploration and the thrill of unexpected discoveries. From ancient forests teeming with aberrant creatures to boundless deserts swept by dust storms, the game offers multiple unique and exquisitely crafted maps, each paired with exclusive NPC factions and commercial systems.

Immerse yourself in the beautifully crafted landscapes while traveling between regions, trading local specialties, profiting from commerce, and seeking out powerful Easter eggs that transcend the ages.

A Cozy, Safe, Miraculous Stronghold Built by You

Establish a miraculous stronghold that belongs only to you within this vast world. Store your supplies, craft your equipment, forge your items, and recruit your companions. Create a peaceful oasis amidst the chaotic Infinite Realm.

A Conspiracy Across Worlds, An Adventure Beyond Time and Space

Mysterious black cards bring you and your companions together from different worlds. The ambition of the shadowy mastermind spreads to every corner of existence. Unveil the dark curtain and let the truth come to light.

You will face a massive conspiracy firsthand in the Infinite Realm, experience thrilling battles and exciting events, uncover the truth behind the world's descent into chaos, confront the ultimate evil, and feel the passion of a fantastical adventure — along with the unique stories of every character you meet.

And there is much more waiting for you to discover.

data.short_description: This is an action-adventure game blending fast-paced hardcore combat with open-world exploration. Travel across infinite realms between different lands. Trade, fight, collect, and develop. Experience thrilling combat in a unique art style and enjoy a captivating story with detailed worlds.
